channel.title: Plumb blog
channel.description: Tips, strategy and behind-the-scenes posts about Plumb.

item.title: Seven beginner tips for Plumb
item.description: Seven practical tips for new Plumb players: read the walls first, count what moves, park marbles, and use undo to learn a board fast.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Calm by design: why Plumb has no timers, lives or energy
item.description: Plumb has no timers, no lives and no energy, and no ad ever interrupts a puzzle. Why we built a game that respects your time, and what that means in it.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How Plumb levels are made: a generator, a solver, no repeats
item.description: Behind the scenes: how Plumb's levels are generated, proven solvable, checked so no two are alike, and ordered so the game never gets easier.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How Plumb's hint works, and when to use it
item.description: Plumb's hint previews your best next tilt right on the board: ghost marbles, dotted trails and pit warnings. Here is what each part means.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How to play Plumb: the rules in two minutes
item.description: Learn to play Plumb, the marble tilt puzzle: swipe to tilt the board, every marble rolls at once, and each one must drop into the hole of its own colour.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Made by two: a human and an AI building a puzzle game
item.description: Plumb is made by a two-person team: Shravan Goswami and Claude Opus 5.5, an AI model. How the work is split, and what it is like.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Pits, undo and restart: how to play Plumb without fear
item.description: Square pits swallow any marble in Plumb, but a mistake costs you one tap. How pits work, what undo and restart do, and why there are no lives.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: How to get three stars in Plumb: par, explained
item.description: What par means in Plumb, how stars are scored, and a simple method for finding the perfect route on any level, with a worked example.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5

item.title: Why four directions go so deep: the maths of tilting
item.description: Plumb has only four moves, yet late levels take a dozen tilts to solve. How one swipe moving every marble creates a huge space of positions.
item.author: Shravan Goswami, Claude Opus 5.5
